title: Yugen Mosaic
description: Yugen Mosaic is a free app that creates digital art pictures based on your own images. With it, you can use an unlimited amount of images, to create a photo mosaic which is an image composed of many tiled photos. or you can create some "Ascii" "Art", this graphic design technique will recreate your pictures with a set of printable characters pieced together. Yugen is an awareness of the universe that triggers emotional responses too deep and powerful for words, and that is just what your art will do with a little help from Yugen Mosaic!

links.description: Open Yugen Mosaic in the Microsoft Store
Open Yugen Mosaic repo on GitHub.
